title: What does a Mark III keep when she picks it up?
question: Tapping a robot and choosing 'pick it up' boxes it back into her pocket, and putting it down again starts it fresh. That is fine for a Mark I, which keeps nothing worth keeping. A Mark III carries a week of practice in it. If picking it up wipes that, the first time she moves it to a better spot she loses everything it learned, and nothing on screen will explain why it is clumsy again.
why_now: Picking up already exists in the menu, so the v0.2.1 build hits this the first time anyone moves a Mark III. It is a one-line rule either way, but it is your rule.

options.label: The crate remembers (Recommended)
options.detail: Its weights and its days travel with the boxed item and come back when it is put down. Moving a robot costs nothing. About half a day: the item carries the learned state, and the round trip is tested.

options.label: Picking it up resets it
options.detail: Simplest, and it is what the code does today. Honest, but it makes 'move it' and 'forget everything' the same tap, which will read as broken.

options.label: It keeps its practice but forgets the map
options.detail: Weights survive, the running score and baseline reset, so a moved robot starts a fresh week from what it knows. A middle path that needs a sentence of design; not worth it unless option a proves confusing in play.
